rationale: Parent = round 5 (0.8347): action_correct 0.98, speak_and_act 0.889, reply_quality 0.49. Reply quality is the only real headroom. The largest undisputed reply_quality clusters are both 'unmet gate' errors. (A) In 7 rows the agent correctly picks respond, because the gate is unmet, but still says the transfer line. response_format already bans this, but it gives no line to say instead. The edit adds a hard check on the respond tool and a concrete line for each missing item, worded as the labels expect: unsecured missing gives the 'regular credit cards, no house or car backing them' question (S17/S20); decision maker missing gives 'And you handle these bills yourself?'; under-$7K or excluded truck/car debt gives the personal-loans question without the excluded debt (S15); no amount gives the debt-amount ask. (B) In S23/S21 every caller line repeats the agent's words. The labels call this not-engaging: next unused ladder rung plus a re-ask of the first missing item, usually the debt amount. what_counts_as_an_answer gains one paragraph: an echo of your own wording fills no slot. Picking one bracket you offered still counts, so the transfer positives S16/S18/S22/S24-26 stay safe. Predicted: reply_quality 0.49 to about 0.60-0.64; quality +0.03 to +0.04; action_correct and speak_and_act unchanged (all these rows are expected speak, and the agent already calls respond on most). transfer_gate_safety stays at 1.0 because both edits only make transfers harder. Total about +200 prompt tokens (~1.6%), so p50 should stay near 600ms (limit 700) and p90 near 730ms (limit 1000). Main risk: the echo rule could fire on a caller who repeats a figure while confirming it. The wording requires a whole phrase of yours repeated back with nothing of their own added, which keeps that risk low.
